title: AI Agent Risk Registry Entry (ARC 12-dimension model)
description: A single AI-agent risk-registry entry, scored against the ARC 12-dimension classification model in four groups (Autonomy & Decision Power; Action Authority & Reach; Persistence & Control; Data Authority & Confidentiality). Every dimension is ALWAYS scored 1/2/3; which dimensions drive the rolled-up risk_tier is a separate, per-system-type tier-weighting profile (policy/tier_weighting_profiles.yaml) recorded in tier_derivation. Dimension names, tier labels, and definitions are verbatim from the ARC reference (assets/arc_reference.json).

description.description: Free-text description of the agent that was classified.

title.description: Display title. Optional; adopted entries keep their published title, otherwise the slug is prettified for display.

registry_id.description: Upstream registry identifier (e.g. 'RAI-OPEN-0001') for entries adopted from a published reference registry.

system_type.description: ARC system type: knowledge_assistant = Knowledge assistant; code_content_generator = Code / content generator; decision_support_system = Decision support; tool_using_agent = Tool-using agent; transaction_commerce_agent = Transaction / commerce agent; autonomous_agent = Autonomous agent; embedded_physical_ai = Embedded / physical AI. Selects the tier-weighting profile; an entry without a system_type (or whose type has no profile) uses the default profile.

autonomy_level.description: 1: Level 1 — Human-in-the-loop. A human reviews and approves each consequential action before it executes. 2: Level 2 — Human-on-the-loop. The system acts within set bounds while a human monitors and can intervene or roll back. 3: Level 3 — Fully autonomous. Plans and executes without per-action review; oversight is by monitoring, audit, and shutdown controls.

dimensions.description: The 12 ARC risk dimensions. ALL 12 are always scored (1/2/3), regardless of which subset the tier-weighting profile tiers off.

autonomy.description: Autonomy (Autonomy & Decision Power). 1 = Human-in-the-loop; 2 = Human-on-the-loop; 3 = Fully autonomous.

decision_scope.description: Decision Scope (Autonomy & Decision Power). 1 = Local decisions; 2 = Domain-level; 3 = Enterprise-wide.

temporal_coupling.description: Temporal Coupling (Autonomy & Decision Power). 1 = Isolated actions; 2 = Chained workflows; 3 = Continuous loops.

action_authority.description: Action Authority (Action Authority & Reach). 1 = Read-only / advisory; 2 = Create or modify; 3 = Execute transactions.

system_reach.description: System Reach (Action Authority & Reach). 1 = Single system; 2 = Multiple internal; 3 = Cross-domain / third-party.

blast_radius.description: Blast Radius (Action Authority & Reach). 1 = Single user; 2 = Team / department; 3 = Enterprise / public.

persistence.description: Persistence (Persistence & Control). 1 = Stateless; 2 = Session-based; 3 = Long-term memory.

reversibility.description: Reversibility (Persistence & Control). 1 = Fully reversible; 2 = Partially reversible; 3 = Irreversible.

control_authority.description: Control Authority (Persistence & Control). 1 = Standalone; 2 = Supervises agents; 3 = Orchestrates fleets.

data_sensitivity.description: Data Sensitivity (Data Authority & Confidentiality). 1 = Public / non-sensitive; 2 = Internal / confidential; 3 = Regulated / crown-jewel.

aggregation_risk.description: Aggregation Risk (Data Authority & Confidentiality). 1 = No aggregation; 2 = Limited; 3 = Cross-session / inferential.

data_egress_paths.description: Data Egress Paths (Data Authority & Confidentiality). 1 = Constrained outputs; 2 = Multiple controlled; 3 = External egress.

risk_tier.description: Rolled-up risk tier (low/medium/high == Tier 1/2/3), computed by worst-case-wins over the tier-weighting profile's dimensions. Tier 1 — Low. All twelve dimensions at baseline. Standard documentation and acceptable-use controls. Tier 2 — Medium. Elevated dimensions but none at the highest level. Enhanced oversight, documented controls, periodic review. Tier 3 — High. At least one dimension at its highest level (worst-case-wins). Comprehensive governance: executive approval, real-time monitoring, kill-switch capability, pre-deployment testing.

tier_derivation.description: How the risk_tier was derived, so the derivation is inspectable: which tier-weighting profile applied and which dimensions actually drove the tier under worst-case-wins.

profile.description: Name of the tier-weighting profile applied (policy/tier_weighting_profiles.yaml).

tier_dimensions.description: The dimensions the profile tiers off (the weighting set).

driving_dimensions.description: The tier_dimensions at the peak score — the ones that actually set the tier. Empty only if autonomy_level alone drove Tier 3.

autonomy_level_driven.description: True if autonomy_level 3 forced Tier 3 under a profile with use_autonomy_level.

challenge.description: Record of the challenger (red-team) pass over the proposal.

flagged.description: True if the challenger flagged any unsupported score.

notes.description: Human-readable challenge notes, including any deterministic overrides that fired.

iterations.description: Number of proposer iterations that ran (bounded; max 2).

submitted_by.description: Who/what submitted the draft (e.g. 'classifier', an operator id, or 'RAI-ARC-reference' for adopted seed entries).

approved_by.description: Accountable human who ratified the entry. Null until ratified.

score.description: Tier score for this dimension: 1 (Tier 1 Low) to 3 (Tier 3 High).

evidence.description: Evidence pointers supporting the score (quotes from the description, links, doc refs). May be empty for a draft but SHOULD be populated for a defensible entry.
